route: The precursor machine layer materializes the surveyor prism from site casts; visualFactory dispatches its kind to the procedural machine builder. It also appears in Verge faction kind tables.
status: The decorative ring was removed, and the production builder now uses a manufactured prism body, connected sensor and shared generated surface. The scanner's existing motion and activation remain in use; the visual endpoint was shortened. Further variation and natural-encounter review remain open.
caveat: Actual production-factory controls were rendered in Helios and Veil with loaded and fallback surfaces. A real context-loss/restore probe passed after an earlier immediate-restore probe timed out. Three target draws match the ringless control, while shared geometry rises from 408 to 1,534 triangles and the new 256px texture adds estimated GPU residency. A natural encounter and live frame-time impact remain unverified.
